# Client reports

One JSON file per service and day, named `<service>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.json` (with an optional
`-<suffix>` for a write check), written by `scripts/client-report.sh` against the owner's own
Plex, Sonarr or Radarr and committed by the owner. Each records what the requests holdfast's
shipped clients send came to: versions, HTTP status codes, counts, booleans and failure classes.

A report carries no address, host name, port, URL, credential, machine identifier, title, path,
user name or device name: it is written through one closed structure that has no field for any
of them, and the command refuses to write it if the resolved credential or the configured
address is anywhere in its bytes. `scripts/client-report.sh --verify <file>` re-runs the
structure check on a report, and `make check` runs it over every report in this directory.
`docs/client-reports.md` says how to run it and what it records.

The files here are evidence from real services. Nothing in this directory is generated by the
gate or CI, and a report is never edited by hand: a wrong one is replaced by a new run.
